t: Focal Logistics Group announces consolidation of end-to-end logistics services
html:
Focal Logistics Group has officially been launched as a new group of companies, bringing together the logistics operations of Focal Maritime Services, Greenwaveshipping.mt, Combined Maritime Services and Delta Container Services under one unified brand. The move marks a major strategic evolution, from a purely maritime-focused operation to a fully integrated logistics group offering comprehensive, seamless services across sea, land and air.

Driven by growing client demand for more cohesive and efficient solutions, Focal Logistics Group is now positioned to manage the entire logistics cycle, including multimodal transport, customs clearance and warehousing, all through a single point of contact.

This transformation also includes a full rebranding and structural reorganisation, aimed at reinforcing governance, ensuring business continuity and preparing the company for the next generation of leadership.

The group will be led by Anton Xerri as Chief Executive Officer, Ramona Saliba as Chief Commercial Officer, Jesmond Abela as Chief Operations Officer and Kimberly Camilleri as Financial Controller. Godwin Xerri will assume the role of Chairperson of the newly established group.

“The creation of Focal Logistics Group is a natural next step in our journey. Our clients’ needs have evolved, and so have we, offering a unified, customer-centric and future-ready service across the entire logistics chain,” said Anton Xerri, CEO. “While the brand and structure are evolving, existing channels and client touchpoints will remain unchanged to ensure a smooth transition. Clients can expect the same reliability and professionalism — now with an even stronger capacity to deliver”, he added.

Godwin Xerri, Group Chairperson, added: “This development represents the culmination of decades of expertise, now coming together under one banner. This is all about continuity, backed by a clear vision for growth, innovation and leadership across the logistics sector in Malta and beyond. With a dynamic team, fresh energy, and the same trusted relationships, we are building on our legacy while embracing the future.”
